title: 02 East cell's 3V3 from the east margin of the In3 plane; three vias that join nothing removed
why: R807 and R801 are fed by a 36 mm B.Cu track from the plane edge at y 70.4, though In3 is 3V3 only 5 mm east of the cell (x > 238). The joins at R601, R701 and R801 each carry a via whose two tracks are both on B.Cu.
